sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Ballyfermot" (cons 15). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Seven, the area named for Ballyfermot, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
